median_age.note: OCHA's population table for Chad (reference year 2023) gives Ennedi Est and Ennedi Ouest the same age proportions, to within 0.05 of a point in every five-year group: one structure applied to both provinces, so no median age of Ennedi Est's own can be taken from it.

sex_ratio.note: OCHA's population table for Chad (reference year 2023) gives Ennedi Est and Ennedi Ouest the same age proportions, to within 0.05 of a point in every five-year group, and the same proportion of men (1,139 per 1,000 women): one structure applied to both provinces, so no sex ratio of Ennedi Est's own can be taken from it.
